balance_check_failure_reason: Relayer submitted a group of 7 transactions (1 refund + 6 opups) paying a 3000 microAlgos fee per transaction, totaling 21000 microAlgos in fees. The Python off-chain assertion expected the relayer balance to only drop by a max fee of 10000. As a result, the check `r_algo_end > r_algo_start + ALGO_AMOUNT - 10000` failed, despite the 500000 inner payment executing successfully.
safety_confirmation: Read-only strictly followed. Zero transactions submitted.
